newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Another record for NSW Australia grain crop.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Another record for NSW Australia grain crop.

text.p: GrainCorp, the leading grain handling cooperative in New South Wales, said on Tuesday it had received a record 1.64 million tonnes of grain in the past week to produce the largest receivals in 12 years.
This brought total receivals in the current harvest to 5.16 million tonnes of grain, it said. An estimated further 1.5 to 1.8 million tonnes was yet to be received, it said.
The only larger harvest received was eight million tonnes in 1983/84, but that was in a regulated market, it said.
GrainCorp said some of the best harvesting conditions of the season prevailed last week, helping wind up the harvest in the Narrabri region and set record receivals at several sites.
It said the harvest focus had now turned to central and southern New South Wales.

With receivals in the north nearly complete, northern grain handling machinery had been freed for use in central and southern New South Wales. This would greatly aid in the receival of grain in these areas, GrainCorp said.
Grain quality was reported as very good in areas where harvesting had just begun, but yields were variable, it said.
The rail overflow programme had so far moved more than 500,000 tonnes of grain, it said.
Last week new grain exports began from the ports of Newcastle and Port Kembla. More than 160,000 tonnes of grain already had been moved to port for export, it said.
